seoTitle: News Sitemap Freshness Checker (48 Hour Rule)
metaDescription: Show how old each article in a Google News sitemap is and list entries older than 48 hours to remove. Free, runs locally.
intro: Reads a news sitemap, shows the age of each article and lists the stale ones.
why:
Google asks for news sitemaps to hold only articles from the last two days. Old entries add noise and are a sign the file is not being cleaned.

Paste the sitemap to see each article age. You can change the hour limit or set a reference time, which helps when you test a saved file.
howTo: Keep 48 hours or set another limit.
Read the status of each article.

faq.a: Google says the last two days. 48 hours is the usual reading and you can change it.
Remove them. An empty news sitemap is fine.
It reports missing, invalid and future publication dates.
